summary: The change adds a writing rule to the creator brief agent. There is 1 Must finding: the rule names a quality, not a behavior.

items.quote: Summarize the page in chat, with a table of every creator.
items.fix: Reply with the answer, up to three points that each name the creator and the number behind it, the next step in one line, and the page link.

findings.why: It names a quality, so no reader can check whether a page meets it.
findings.fix: No arrows, no 'vs', one idea per sentence, sentences of at most 25 words.

findings.quote:
Where possible, try to cite
the newest post.
findings.why: A step the agent must do reads as optional.
findings.fix: Cite the newest post Atlas holds for each account.
